page.title: Publishing
page.description: An attraction, a stay or a food listing goes live when the desk responsible for it says so. Partners are answered by a BDO, contributors by an editor, and editors and BDOs by an administrator.

awaiting.title: Awaiting your decision
awaiting.description: Approving publishes the listing in the same step.

changes.title: Waiting on changes
changes.description: Sent back to their author, and off your queue until they answer.
changes.empty: Nothing is waiting on its author.

submit.title: Submit for publishing
submit.description: What you own that is not live and not already with a reviewer — including anything sent back for changes.
